fact: WHO Gabon's 2024 annual report states that the health information directorate drew up a Plan stratégique 2024-2028 providing for DHIS2 as the main tool, that DHIS2 has been in use since December 2024 and integrates all functional public health facilities with private ones to follow in 2025, and that 122 data managers and 10 regional health directors from all 51 départements and 10 régions were trained and equipped (96 laptops, 122 modems), report completeness rising from 60% to 85% thirty days after launch.
title: Rapport Annuel 2024
publisher: Organisation mondiale de la Santé, Bureau du Gabon
